{{Top|leg}}
The '''2-ZHb''' was a variant of the [[2-ZH surgical droid]]. Vibrant blue in [[Color/Legends|color]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] resembled the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]]. It was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Planet/Legends|planetside]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
